description: This source file defines an enum GatewayDiscoveryPreferences that manages user preferences related to gateway stable IDs, using UserDefaults for storage. It provides methods to retrieve and set the preferred stable ID, handling legacy keys and whitespace trimming.

methods.name: preferredStableID
